children.name: Borassus

children.name: Borassus aethiopum
children.description: Borassus aethiopum is a species of Borassus palm from Africa.

children.name: Borassus flabellifer

children.name: Borassus akeassii

children.name: Borassus heineanus
children.description: Borassus heineanus is a species of a large solitary fan palm found only in northern New Guinea, in both Papua New Guinea and Indonesia, where it is threatened by habitat loss.

children.name: Borassus madagascariensis
children.description: Borassus madagascariensis is a species in the palm family Arecales endemic to Madagascar.

children.name: Bismarckia
children.description: Bismarckia — a genus of liliopsidas.

children.description: Bismarckia is a monotypic genus of flowering plant in the palm family with Bismarckia nobilis being the only species in the genus and is endemic to western and northern Madagascar, where it grows in open grassland. Bismarckia nobilis is widely cultivated in tropical and subtropical regions of the world.
